meta_description_en: Outlet #025 editorial: announcing the upcoming 3" disc version for ZX Spectrum +3, seeking RAMTOP routines, planning a UDG bank project, and celebrating Outlet's 3rd year.
meta_description_ru: Редакционная колонка Outlet #025: анонс версии журнала на 3" диске для ZX Spectrum +3, поиск метода сдвига RAMTOP, сбор банка UDG и благодарности к 3-летию журнала.
body_en_plain:
A new, +3 version of OUTLET will
be launched next month!The price
has not been decided at the time
of writing as we are considering
the higher price of 3" discs but
it should be around the `3.50 to
`4.00 mark.It will fill one side
of a "super-formatted" disc!

If anyone has a way of moving up
RAMTOP (but without clearing the
screen)on the +3 please write in
and tell us as our CLEARCUT does
not work!

Despite writing several times we
have still not received any word
from that reviewer at the "Dutch
Discovery Club"  about reviewing
the "AMX Mouse" routine he wrote
so we've given up on that one!

One project we have planned is a
general-purpose UDG bank program
so if you have any UDGs send 'em
in!If you don't have the UDG but
would like to request one send a
description. The concept is when
you need some UDGs you load this
program and pick what you want.

Finally,as we enter OUTLET's 3rd
year we'd like to thank everyone
for their support which has been
terrific - we have learned a lot
and enjoyed and used - and still
use -  many of the programs sent
in to us so we are sure that you
do too!




       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.

body_en:
## Editorial

A new, +3 version of OUTLET will be launched next month! The price has not been decided at the time of writing as we are considering the higher price of 3" discs but it should be around the `3.50 to `4.00 mark. It will fill one side of a "super-formatted" disc!

If anyone has a way of moving up RAMTOP (but without clearing the screen) on the +3 please write in and tell us as our CLEARCUT does not work!

Despite writing several times we have still not received any word from that reviewer at the "Dutch Discovery Club" about reviewing the "AMX Mouse" routine he wrote so we've given up on that one!

One project we have planned is a general-purpose UDG bank program so if you have any UDGs send 'em in! If you don't have the UDG but would like to request one send a description. The concept is when you need some UDGs you load this program and pick what you want.

Finally, as we enter OUTLET's 3rd year we'd like to thank everyone for their support which has been terrific - we have learned a lot and enjoyed and used - and still use - many of the programs sent in to us so we are sure that you do too!

```text
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.
```
body_ru:
## От редакции

Новая версия OUTLET для +3 будет запущена в следующем месяце! Цена на момент написания не определена, ведь мы учитываем более высокую цену 3" дисков, но она будет в районе от `3.50 до `4.00. Она займет одну сторону "суперформатированного" диска!

Если у кого-то есть способ сдвинуть RAMTOP вверх (но без очистки экрана) на +3, напишите нам, ведь наш CLEARCUT не работает!

Несмотря на несколько писем, мы так и не получили ответа от того рецензента из "Dutch Discovery Club" насчет обзора подпрограммы для "AMX Mouse", написанной им, так что мы бросили эту затею!

Один из запланированных нами проектов — универсальная программа банка UDG, так что если у вас есть UDG, присылайте их! Если у вас нет нужного UDG, но хотите заказать его, пришлите описание. Суть в том, что когда вам нужны UDG, вы грузите эту программу и выбираете все, что вам угодно.

И наконец, на пороге 3-го года OUTLET, мы хотим поблагодарить всех за поддержку — она была потрясающей! Мы многому научились, с удовольствием использовали — и до сих пор используем — многие из присланных нам программ, так что уверены: вы делаете то же!

```text
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.
```
